paths.requires: OAuth token with the youtube scope on the destination channel
paths.operator_action: sign in with the channel that will receive the stream
paths.note: The API returns cdn.ingestionInfo.ingestionAddress + streamName. Creating a liveStream resource does not start or announce a broadcast.

paths.requires: Twitch app client id + a user access token with the channel:read:stream_key scope, and the broadcaster id
paths.operator_action: register a Twitch application (free) and authorise it as the broadcaster
paths.note: The endpoint requires a *user* access token; an app access token cannot read a stream key. Twitch answers 403 for accounts not permitted to stream.

paths.requires: Kick user token carrying the streamkey:read scope
paths.operator_action: register a Kick application (free) and authorise the channel
paths.note: The key and its ingest URL arrive as data[].stream.key / .url; Kick publishes no standalone stream-key endpoint. Documented but never exercised by this repo.

paths.requires: Page access token with the live-video permission on that Page
paths.operator_action: connect the Page (a personal profile cannot go live through the API)
paths.note: Page destinations only; the Page token is the credential. xPST creates the stream with published=false, so fetching a key does not put anything on the Page.

paths.requires: a public account with at least 1,000 followers
paths.operator_action: open instagram.com → Create → Live video (Live Producer) and copy the server URL plus the per-session stream key
paths.note: Keys are per session by design, so a relay cannot be configured once and forgotten. An official Live API for eligible accounts is reported but unconfirmed for this repository; until it is proven, this row stays manual.

paths.requires: LIVE access on the account (18+, 1,000 followers)
paths.operator_action: open TikTok LIVE Center, start a live setup, copy the RTMP URL and key
paths.note: Per-session key with no documented endpoint for handing one to an app.

paths.operator_action: copy the RTMP ingest URL and stream key from the Rumble studio

paths.note: No live-video ingest API for third-party apps.
No live ingest; AT Protocol carries posts, not broadcast.

steps: Register an application at https://dev.twitch.tv/console/apps (free, no review).
Authorise it as the broadcaster with the channel:read:stream_key scope; the result is a user access token. An app access token cannot read a stream key.
Store the pair with `xpst stream app-credentials twitch --client-id … --access-token … --user-id <broadcaster id>`.
Create an app in the Kick developer settings (free).
Run the OAuth 2.1 authorisation-code flow for the channel with the streamkey:read (and channel:read, for live status) scopes.
Store the pair with `xpst stream app-credentials kick --client-id … --access-token … --user-id <broadcaster user id>`.

simulcast_refusals.tiktok_shop: TikTok Shop prohibits simulcasting the same live to other platforms
simulcast_refusals.twitch_redirect: Twitch forbids redirecting viewers to another platform from a stream
